notes: 05 동작 시뮬레이션. Data: fin/sim/keyaction.json (model_v4.py r4.5 Dyn histories, white D / black C#, 0.8 N push + 0.5/0.7/1.0/1.5/2.5 m/s strike -> 1 N hold -> let go, decimated piecewise-linear, two identical settled-rest prefix rows at t = 0 and 5 ms so the finger force steps on at 5 ms; side-section outlines from geometry.json at the balance-pin plane; sensor law; metrics.json numbers incl. the lever mass breakdown; 73 self-checks) and fin/sim/system.json (88-key signal map from hardware/pcb netlist.csv / wiring_MB.csv (read by header names: 넷, 시작/끝 + x/y, 경로, 길이 (mm), 꺾임 수; every key checked to have an A302 segment) / mux_module_pins.csv / harness.csv / cables.csv (rev E: each module's own USB cable W201~W207 with length and hub port -> keys[].usb_cable / usb_port, shown in the chain node and the 'USB' row; W208 pedal 0.5 m), SCH-06 power budget via sheets.budget(), touchscreen fold outlines cut from the CAD solids; circuit revision read from hardware/pcb/netlist/sheets.json and written into .sim-rev spans; sustain-pedal path built from the SCH-05 netlist rows; fuse F601 from bom.csv; per-key scan rate marked as an estimate, 4 us settle + 2 us conversion per channel). Hover titles of drawn fixed parts use Korean final-part names (ko field). Toggle buttons (sustain, mute, screen) keep a fixed label and show state with aria-pressed. Both regenerate with: python3 hardware/mechanical/key-action-v4/model/export_sim.py --cad-check (about 100 s; never runs build_all.main). Lazy: fetches both JSON files when #p-sim first becomes visible. Uses only the page tokens; drawing sheets and the keyboard use --d-* tokens (one literal PCB green inside .sim-draw). API: window.toccata.sim = {ready, setRun(colour, runId), setTime(ms), noteOn(midi), noteOff(midi)}. WebAudio tone starts on the first key press (user gesture). Element ids all start with sim-. The dynamics use the pad-seat stiffness of the verified run (1490 N/mm, metrics.json seat.k_min) because build_geo's plate FE gives 1410 N/mm with this machine's numpy/scipy; with 1490 every compared case equals metrics.json. The magnet/sensor inset is a real copy of the #sim-world group (ids stripped, built once per drawing; key/lever transforms and 'hot' marks mirrored each frame), not <use>, because page CSS does not reach <use> shadow clones.
